command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
mkdir -p normalized
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
import tempfile

base = Path('/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization')
incoming = base / 'incoming'
normalized = base / 'normalized'
rows = base.joinpath('encodings.tsv').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
failures = 0
for line_no, row in enumerate(rows[1:], 2):
    if not row.strip():
        continue
    fields = row.split()
    if len(fields) != 2:
        print(f'ERROR manifest line {line_no}: expected filename and encoding', file=os.sys.stderr)
        failures += 1
        continue
    name, encoding = fields
    src = incoming / name
    dst = normalized / name
    tmp_name = None
    try:
        raw = src.read_bytes()
        text = raw.decode(encoding, errors='strict')
        text = text.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n')
        payload = text.encode('utf-8', errors='strict')
        fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f'.{name}.', dir=normalized)
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as out:
            out.write(payload)
            out.flush()
            os.fsync(out.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp_name, dst)
        tmp_name = None
        print(f'OK {name}: {encoding} -> UTF-8, {len(raw)} input bytes, {len(payload)} output bytes')
    except (UnicodeError, LookupError, OSError) as exc:
        failures += 1
        print(f'ERROR {name}: {exc}', file=os.sys.stderr)
    finally:
        if tmp_name is not None:
            try:
                os.unlink(tmp_name)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
print(f'COMPLETE published={len(rows)-1-failures} rejected={failures}')
PY

}
